statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance (I49.9)
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The symptoms are uncontrolled in nature
Continuous monitoring is needed to identify the arrhythmia responsible for the patient's presentation
